title: Reindexed junta restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be a coordinate set with a fixed sign assignment $z$ on $P$. The reindexed restriction is the Boolean function on the coordinates outside $P$ obtained by fixing the coordinates in $P$ according to $z$ and identifying the remaining coordinates with a cube of dimension equal to their number.
hypotheses_covered: The target is a Boolean function on $n$ sign coordinates.
$z$ assigns a sign to each coordinate in $P$.
caveat: The supplied statement refers to the restriction and reindexing maps without including their definitions, so their precise coordinate convention is unavailable.
